Task 6059 landed on main in merge commit 1ac3835e85 on 2026-10-18. Since then fused-memory/src/fused_memory/utils/referent_resolution.py::_conflicting_referents treats the scanner's silence about a declared task as uninformative per referent: a declaration is rejected only on positive evidence (a near-miss typo of a scanned task number that the content never writes, or the declared number under another project), and an add_memory whose explicit category discards the declaration (a Mem0-primary write without dual_write) is never conflict-rejected. Declaring `entities` is the expected default. Keep declaring; if a write is rejected, fix the wrong id, or write that task as "task NNN" in the content. Do NOT omit `entities`: on a Graphiti-primary write, omitting it misattributes the memory to whichever task the scanner could see, and the declaration rate is the adoption signal of plans/memory-referent-fidelity-prd.md decision 4. This repair is task 6060 (phase 1), task 6067 (phase 2) and task 7117 (phase 3).

More evidence for the add_memory entities-gate false-conflict bug (owner task 6059), seen 2026-10-01 during a /reflect. Four of eight writes were rejected with DeclaredReferentConflictRejected when the content referred to tasks by bare number ("5303", "landed with 5303", "Residual of 5303") while entities declared {'kind':'task','id':5303}. As a result, every declared task counted as a conflict. Workaround: write "task 5303" (with the word) so the scanner sees the referent (do NOT omit `entities` — see the correction above).

Hand-carry mechanics that worked on 2026-10-05 (task 5344 via carrier task 6377): (a) implement in an out-of-tree worktree (.claude/worktrees/hc-<id>), and when review fixes arrive while a full test_command run is still going in that tree, branch a SECOND worktree from the rebased tip for the fixer instead of editing under the running suite; (b) file the carrier up front with submit_task(planning_mode=True) + add_dependency(carrier -> real task) while the real task is held deferred; at submit time `git branch task/<carrier> <tip>` + `git worktree add .worktrees/<carrier>` (no git worktree move, so no broken venv), walk carrier pending -> in-progress (claimant_run_id) -> merge-deferred, submit with verified_green only if the suite ran on that exact tip; (c) the queue was 9 deep: the carrier was coalesced as a NON-TIP train member (superseded_by coalesce-5479-*), the train landed ~3h after submit under the tip's marker, and mark_member_done flipped the merge-deferred carrier to done ~1 min after the marker appeared (no self-stamp needed or allowed); the real task (deferred) was stamped done with found_on_main at its landed rebased commit, proven by `git cherry main task/<carrier>` all '-'. A Bash safety check refused `bash -c "$TC"` (it cannot inspect a variable script for rm); writing the verbatim test_command into a visible script file worked. The fused-memory entities gate rejected declared tasks cited as bare numbers ('carrier 6377', '5371 and 5020') as conflicts; write 'task N' each time (do NOT omit `entities` — see the correction above).

amendments.content:
Gotcha with fused-memory add_memory's referent guard (DeclaredReferentConflictRejected). The content scanner recognises a task id only when the word 'task' precedes it ('task 6567', 'tasks 7043').

Bare numbers in prose — '(6567, 5425)', 'carrier 7045', 'μ 7061' — are not seen as referents. Declaring them in `entities` then counts as a conflict and the whole write is rejected. The scanner can also mint odd referents from phrases like 'Task 4' or 'commits:06'.

Fix: write 'task N' for each id you declare, or pass entities=[] (always accepted). Hit three times on 2026-10-15/16.

Keep them adjacent — `pending` is the dispatchable window. Best sequencing overall: file with planning_mode, stay deferred for the whole implement phase, and only commit_planning -> in-progress immediately before submitting to the merge queue.
